name: cost_effectiveness_plane
description: Incremental cost (y) vs incremental effect (x) plane with four quadrant guide captions, up to 6 intervention points, and an optional willingness-to-pay (WTP) threshold line through the origin. Choose this for ANY request about a cost-effectiveness plane, an incremental cost-effectiveness ratio (ICER) comparison, or plotting interventions by cost and effect. The domain and both axes are computed for you, centered on zero; you only choose the points and, optionally, a WTP threshold.

wtp_threshold.description: Willingness-to-pay slope, cost per unit effect (e.g. 30000 per QALY). The dashed WTP line is drawn only when this is set.

effect.description: Incremental effect, e.g. QALYs gained relative to the comparator.

cost.description: Incremental cost relative to the comparator.

quadrant_labels.description: Small guide captions in each quadrant corner. Default true.

element_ids.x_axis: the horizontal (effect) axis, through the origin, with the x_label caption
element_ids.y_axis: the vertical (cost) axis, through the origin, with the y_label caption
element_ids.wtp_line: the dashed willingness-to-pay threshold line through the origin — present only when wtp_threshold is set
element_ids.wtp_label: the "WTP threshold" caption on that line
element_ids.q_ne / q_nw / q_se / q_sw: small guide captions in each quadrant corner (more/less costly × more/less effective) — present unless quadrant_labels is false
element_ids.pt_<i>: intervention point i (0-indexed, in `points` order) — a dot, tinted with a cost-effective/not halo when wtp_threshold is set
element_ids.title: figure title, when set

examples.request: Show two treatments on a cost-effectiveness plane with a WTP threshold of 30,000 per QALY.
Plot a dominant intervention that costs less and works better than the alternative on a cost-effectiveness plane.
